kill_switch_route_mode.description: When true, hides the 'Walk to a destination' CTA on the Nearby tab so Route Mode can be disabled without a release.

kill_switch_reporting.description: When true, hides the 'Report a missing postbox' and 'Report wrong cypher' entry points app-wide so problem-reporting can be disabled without a release.

james_welcome_variant.description: Postman James's first-launch line variant. 'classic' = the shipped copy; 'cheeky' = the A/B variant. Other values fall back to 'classic'.

maintenance_mode.description: When true, flips the app into read-only mode: a banner shows and every write entry-point (claim, report, friends, settings) refuses with a toast. Emergency kill switch for backend maintenance.

defaultValue.value: The Royal Mail van's pulled in for a service. Have a browse around for a bit, postie...

maintenance_message.description: Admin-authored banner copy shown while maintenance_mode is on. Empty falls back to the in-app default. Postman James voice; no em-dashes.

version.description: Remote Config template for Postbox Game: two kill switches (Route Mode, problem reporting), one A/B copy variant (James welcome line), and the maintenance-mode kill switch + banner message. Defaults mirror RemoteConfigService.defaults in lib/remote_config_service.dart.
